text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete ownership and a light-weight tracker for rollout safety. Goals: auto-rollback/quarantine on bad health signals, and flag-level recurrence detection.
jonathan: I can own the rollout controller prototype. Start simple: waves + holds + auto_rollback rules. Feature-flag it.
linh: Emergency path too: immediate_quarantine when p95 or error spike crosses a severity cutoff. Keep runtime checks tiny.
aqeel: Console tracker - fields: owner, due_date, last_rollback_ts, rollback_count_60d, severity, recommended_action. I'll mock a UX.
maya: Example policy sketch: 
```
flag: ranking-v3
waves:
  - pct: 5
    hold: 15m
  - pct: 25
    hold: 30m
  - pct: 50
    hold: 1h
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  error_rate_threshold: 0.03
  sustained_minutes: 5
emergency:
  p95_ms_threshold: 5000
  immediate_quarantine: true
```
jonathan: During each hold, if error_rate > threshold for sustained_minutes OR p95 > threshold -> immediate quarantine + notify owner/oncall. If issue persists after quarantine window, controller rolls back.
linh: Add maintenance_lock TTL so we don't auto-act during planned windows. Also per-flag overrides to tune noisy models.
maya: Action items:
- maya: write acceptance criteria + link to postmortem  ETA Mon
- jonathan: rollout controller prototype + tests + metrics hooks  ETA Wed
- linh: emergency policy runtime spec + maintenance_lock impl  ETA Thu
- aqeel: tracker backend + nightly job for recurring detection (rule: rollback_count_60d >=3) + console mockups  ETA Thu EOD
- sre-bot: add weekly digest for rolled-back flags to #eng-sre
sre-bot: Created task T-4987 and scheduled weekly digest Mon 09:00 UTC.
jonathan: I'll add noise-smoothing (moving median 5m) and allow per-flag threshold overrides in the PR.
aqeel: Tracker will auto-create review tickets for recurring flags and tag product ops.
maya: Note: do NOT auto-kill Dedicated/Private customer models unless explicitly opted in. Add tenant gate in controller.
linh: Also add a manual quarantine button in Console so humans can act before auto systems.
maya: Great. Drop PRs and mock links here when ready; we'll review in Friday triage. :thumbsup:
